description: Add a new deal (opportunity) to a pipeline, or edit one by opportunity_id — only the fields given change. A contact is matched by email or phone, or created, from contact_name/contact_email/contact_phone/company. Use crm_move_opportunity to just move a deal or mark it won or lost.

lost_reason.description: Why it was lost, when status is lost.

name.description: What the deal is, e.g. "Marcus — booth rental".

opportunity_id.description: Leave out to create a new deal.

pipeline.description: Pipeline name or id. Optional if there's only one, or when editing.

source.description: Where the lead came from, e.g. Instagram, referral, walk-in.

stage.description: Stage name or id. New deals default to the first stage.

name: crm_save_opportunity
title: Add or edit a deal
